name: The Survivor Files with Elizabeth Smart

episodes.title: Cornell Case: The Survivors' Take with Kimberly Corban and JoDee Neil
episodes.description: As the sexual assault allegations at Cornell University dominate the headlines, Elizabeth and fellow survivors Kimberly Corban and JoDee Neil engage in a challenging conversation about consent, reporting, bystanders, and what people still getting wrong about trauma. Plus the "Three D" rules for protecting young people at college parties. See omnystudio.com/listener for privacy information.
